desc: Library or population of small probabilistic programs as causal simulators, revised by program synthesis and chosen by compression, prediction and discriminating interventions
Explicit object/causal graph that predicts observations and revises its structure from prediction error (hidden variables, link splits, reversals), with interventions inside the graph
Embedding-indexed map of verified per-region error rates, used to choose between answering, abstaining, asking, or routing the region to learning
Internal economy where different modules bid for compute, are paid by realized uncertainty reduction, and evolve through copying with mutation and retirement
Persistent justification graph with contradiction checking and truth-maintenance retraction that propagates to dependent conclusions; generation must cite ledger nodes
Surprise-triggered fast episodic store or weight patches, consolidated offline through replay, gated by interference and regression checks to avoid catastrophic forgetting
Iterative energy-minimizing constraint satisfaction over variables and sub-goals, run until a checker confirms success, adding intermediate variables and storing templates
Learned latent predictive world model (JEPA-style) used for model-predictive planning and search over imagined rollouts
Embodied active-inference agent that minimizes free energy through perception and action loops, grounding concepts in sensorimotor experience
Vector-symbolic or hyperdimensional binding that gives compositional, variable-binding symbolic structure inside distributed representations
Intrinsically motivated, open-ended self-play that generates its own goals and curriculum through curiosity and learning progress
Global-workspace architecture where specialist modules compete for a limited-capacity broadcast bottleneck, giving serial conscious-like control
Meta-learned local synaptic plasticity rules (fast weights, Hebbian) that let the network keep rewiring itself during inference
